comparisons.reason: Both are binary any-comment features over OC_comments with matching null/empty rules, but eligibility differs. Left requires a specific identifiable real event, person, case, organization, place, study, product or documented instance. It excludes vague references. Right also counts 'real situation/personal experience' and 'data-backed situation' as examples. That admits personal anecdotes and unnamed real situations, which are not necessarily identifiable specific cases under left. So right is broader and the extraction functions differ.
